business_problem: Huron is using generative artificial intelligence (AI) to transform the process of launching new clinical trials, a critical component of bringing medical breakthroughs to market. Clinical trials determine whether a planned medical intervention or therapy will have enough financial benefit to validate the investment in research and development, marketing, and production.
solution_summary: Huron is using generative artificial intelligence (AI) to transform the process of launching new clinical trials, a critical component of bringing medical breakthroughs to market. Clinical trials determine whether a planned medical intervention or therapy will have enough financial benefit to validate the investment in research and development, marketing, and production. At first, Huron’s AI team experimented with a proof of concept that was based on predictive modeling, which uses algorithms to analyze historical data and predict outcomes. But Huron realized that the complexity of unstructured data and the need for more nuanced answers warranted another approach. So it shifted to generative AI, first experimenting with a large language model (LLM) from a leading AI provider and building the support infrastructure from scratch.

solution_components.name: Knowledge Bases for Amazon Bedrock
solution_components.role: Indexes enterprise content so the application can ground responses on internal knowledge.

solution_components.name: Amazon Bedrock
solution_components.role: Hosts the foundation models and generative AI application logic.

solution_components.name: Amazon OpenSearch Service
solution_components.role: Stores and retrieves indexed or vectorized content for search and RAG workflows.

data_flow: Data is stored in Amazon OpenSearch Service and processed by Knowledge Bases for Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Bedrock.
